import ast,concurrent.futures,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
folder=Path.cwd()/'snippets/b4';logs=Path('/tmp/b4-query-review')
cases=[
 ('scope_denied','02_scoped_read.py',{'container_id = "C1"':'container_id = "C2"'},0),
 ('scope_missing','02_scoped_read.py',{'container_id = "C1"':'container_id = "C9"'},0),
 ('scope_sql_value','02_scoped_read.py',{'container_id = "C1"':'container_id = "C1\' OR 1=1 --"'},0),
 ('equal_fees','04_check_business_meaning.py',{"('C4','delayed',50)":"('C4','delayed',100)",'expected = 150':'expected = 200'},0),
 ('sql_maximum','03_question_to_sql.py',{'What is the total recorded USD fee for delayed containers?':'What is the maximum recorded USD fee for delayed containers?','expected = [(150,)]':'expected = [(100,)]'},0),
 ('sql_missing','03_question_to_sql.py',{'What is the total recorded USD fee for delayed containers?':'What is the recorded USD fee for container C2?','expected = [(150,)]':'expected = []'},0),
 ('agent_missing','06_agent_queries_database.py',{'Which delayed container has the highest recorded USD fee? Cite source/time.':'What is the recorded USD fee for container C2? Cite source/time.'},0),
 ('agent_limit','06_agent_queries_database.py',{'max_turns=4':'max_turns=1'},1),
]
def run(case):
    name,filename,changes,expected_exit=case
    path=folder/filename;source=path.read_text()
    for old,new in changes.items():
        assert old in source,(name,old)
        source=source.replace(old,new)
    code='exec(compile('+repr(source)+','+repr(str(path))+',"exec"),{"__name__":"__main__","__file__":'+repr(str(path))+'})'
    result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-c',code],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
    out=result.stdout+result.stderr;(logs/(name+'.log')).write_text(out)
    assert (result.returncode==0)==(expected_exit==0),(name,out[-1500:])
    if name.startswith('scope_'): assert 'RESULT: unavailable' in out
    if name=='equal_fees': assert 'actual: 300 FAIL' in out and 'actual: 200 PASS' in out and 'actual: 100 FAIL' in out
    if name=='sql_maximum': assert 'ROWS: [(100,)]' in out
    if name in ['sql_missing','agent_missing']: assert 'ROWS: []' in out,out
    if name=='agent_limit': assert 'INCOMPLETE: turn limit reached.' in out and 'MaxTurnsExceeded' in out
    print(name,'verified',flush=True)
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as pool: list(pool.map(run,cases))
print('ALL EIGHT INPUT/SEMANTIC/STOPPING VARIATIONS PASSED',flush=True)
